name: а
note: The name is ah. In words, stressed а is an open ah; unstressed а is shorter.

name: бэ
note: The name is beh; the word sound is b, as in book. It can also be soft.

name: вэ
note: The name is veh; the word sound is v, as in van. This is not an English B.

name: гэ
note: The name is geh; usually a hard g, as in go. The whole name is not added to a word.

name: дэ
note: The name is deh; the word sound is d, with the tongue close to the upper teeth.

name: е
note: The name is yeh. At a word's start it begins with y; after most consonants it signals softness. Unstressed е changes sound.

name: ё
note: The name is yo. It starts with y here; after most consonants it gives a soft consonant plus o. Ё is normally stressed.

name: же
note: The name sounds like zheh. In words, a voiced sound like s in pleasure, made farther back in the mouth.

name: зэ
note: The name is zeh; the word sound is z, as in zoo. It can also be soft.

name: и
note: The name is ee. A vowel close to ee in see, usually shorter; it normally makes the preceding consonant soft.

name: и кра́ткое
note: Its name means short i, but й is a consonant: a quick y glide, as in yes or the end of boy.

name: ка
note: The name is kah; the word sound is k, with less puff of air than English k in key.

name: эль
note: The name is el. In words, л has hard and soft l sounds; the next letter often tells you which.

name: эм
note: The name is em; the word sound is m, as in mum. It can also be soft.

name: эн
note: The name is en; the word sound is n, as in nose. This is not an English H.

name: о
note: The name is o. Stressed о is a steady rounded vowel, without an English oh glide; unstressed о often sounds closer to ah.

name: пэ
note: The name is peh; the word sound is p, with less puff of air than English p in pen.

name: эр
note: The name is er; the word sound is a tapped or rolled r made with the tongue tip. It is not an English P.

name: эс
note: The name is es; the word sound is s, as in sun. It does not stand for k.

name: тэ
note: The name is teh; the word sound is t, made near the upper teeth with little puff of air.

name: у
note: The name is oo. In words, a rounded vowel close to oo in food, usually shorter. It is not English y.

name: эф
note: The name is ef; the word sound is f, as in flag. It can also be soft.

name: ха
note: The name is khah. The word sound is like ch in Scottish loch: air flows past the raised back of the tongue.

name: це
note: The name sounds like tseh. In words, ts is one joined sound, like the end of cats. Ц is normally hard.

name: че
note: The name is cheh. The word sound is close to ch in cheese, but softer; ч is normally soft.

name: ша
note: The name is shah. The word sound resembles sh, with the tongue farther back; ш is normally hard.

name: ща
note: Say a long, soft sh followed by ah for the name. In words, щ is a long, soft sh, distinct from the harder ш.

name: твёрдый знак
note: The name means hard sign. Ъ has no sound of its own; it separates a consonant from the y sound in е, ё, ю or я.

name: ы
note: The name and vowel sound have no exact English equivalent. Keep your lips unrounded and your tongue farther back than for и.

name: мя́гкий знак
note: The name means soft sign. Ь has no sound of its own; here it makes р soft. It can also separate sounds or mark grammar.

name: э
note: The name is eh. In words, a vowel close to e in bet, with no initial y sound.

name: ю
note: The name sounds like you. It starts with y here; after most consonants it means a soft consonant plus oo.

name: я
note: The name is yah. It starts with y here; after most consonants it means a soft consonant plus ah. Unstressed я changes sound.
